title: Identity, admin session and public status

name.description: The bot's live display name (guild nickname, else global name, else user name) once the gateway is ready; the configured name before that and offline.

version.description: Short hash of the name and the cached art; changes after an identity refresh. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

bot_user_id.description: The bot's Discord user id; null on the public origin and before the gateway is ready. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

method.description: How the session signed in; only `discord` sessions may approve or reject proposals. Always sent by the server; optional so earlier fixtures stay valid.

member.description: The guild member behind a Discord sign-in; null for the admin token, Tailscale, and a Discord account with no member row.

server_time.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

roles.description: Current guild roles, highest first, named only; null while the role directory is unavailable.

allowance.description: The member's row exactly as GET /api/admin/limits shows it; null without chatbot access.

reply_style.description: How chat answers this member; null while no persona is loaded.

ReplyStyle.description: The reply profile in effect and the member's own saved choice; the first role assignment the member holds beats the saved choice.

in_effect.description: What chat uses now; null is the persona's default voice.

role_name.description: The role whose assignment wins (source role), when the role directory can name it.

saved.description: The member's saved choice; null is the default voice.

name.description: The profile's label; the key when its file is no longer readable.

public.description: Members may choose it (Config > Persona visibility).

generated_at.description: The server's clock when this was read (ISO-8601 UTC).

AccountSession.description: One live session of the caller's identity (same sign-in method and subject); handle names it for sign-out, ids and hashes never leave the server.

device.description: Browser and system from the sign-in's User-Agent ("Firefox · macOS"); null when unrecognised.

current.description: The session this request came with.
